```python
def odd_count(lst):
    result = []
    for s in lst:
        n = sum(1 for ch in s if int(ch) % 2 == 1)
        template = "the number of odd elements in the string i of the input."
        result.append(template.replace('i', str(n)))
    return result
```

The note about only replacing the first two words is incorrect. `replace('i', ...)` replaces every `i` in the template, including the ones in "in", "string", and "input". The doctests expect exactly that: `"...elements 4n the str4ng 4 of the 4nput."`
